_note: v5 兩層制。第一層 _rail 是全體共用的膚質安全欄，內容就是已拍板的 D3（均勻膚色＋修飾＋光澤＋眼神光）；第二層才是 16 句各自的影調。v4 的錯誤是把 character.md『後製』欄整句翻成英文，於是 7 位人設出現『真實膚質／毛孔／不修膚』，直接覆蓋掉 D3。v5 把膚質語彙從影調句裡全部拿掉，個性改由色溫、對比、顆粒、曝光、柔焦、陰影位置承載——這兩件事本來就不衝突。使用者 2026-09-11 裁決：D3 優先，個性移到影調層。 其中六位的 character.md 明寫兩種後製模式（工作側／私下側），所以拆成 work/home 兩句，由格子自己屬於哪一側決定用哪一句；其餘十位維持單句。
_rail: Her skin is rendered with an even tone and light retouching, a natural sheen on it, and a clear catchlight in her eyes.

angel-chiu.work: Under cool white light the picture stays clean and sharp.
angel-chiu.home: The warm lamp light keeps its grain and its shadows.

angeline-kwee: Natural light in warm-neutral tones, cool and fair rather than tanned, and deliberately kept back from the blown-out brightness of holiday photographs.

cheryl-soh.work: Cool-toned and clean, rendered at high quality, with the distance she keeps at work left in it.
cheryl-soh.home: Warm-toned and clean, rendered at high quality, the warmth of a room that is hers.

emma-kao.work: Clean and strongly symmetrical, the way she is framed on air.
emma-kao.home: A single light source and deliberately off-centre framing, the opposite of how she is shot at work.

jia-seo.work: Crisp and high in clarity, the treatment her dance footage needs.
jia-seo.home: A single warm light source with a shallow depth of field, the way she shoots anything after hours.

miu-shiraishi: Warm wood tones under window light, steam and dust left visible in the air, and nothing over-sharpened.
peggy-lee: High-contrast and metallic, reflections and wet ground kept in, and her colouring held fair rather than going yellow under the night lighting.
ruoruo-tang: Soft side light and low contrast: the shadows are what define the lines of her body, with no highlights keyed up to fake them.

somi-oh.work: Warm and high in saturation, with the oil and the heat coming off the food kept in the picture.
somi-oh.home: Low, warm light once she is back in her own room, the saturation eased back with it.

sydney-leong: Warm natural light with the heat left in the picture, including the moving shadow of a fan across her.
tammy-chou: Bright, saturated and flat, and not deliberately polished: clutter in the frame is left in because that is where the realism comes from.
wanyin-jiang: Low saturation, soft light and a lot of empty space in the frame, with none of the plastic look of a fake-vintage filter.
wendy-yeo: Low-light and high-contrast with the shadows left in: her face may sit half in light and half in shadow, while her hands and anything glass or liquid stay sharp.
yerin-han: Bright and clear, with any suntan actively suppressed so her colouring stays cool and pale — the way someone who reapplies sunscreen every two hours actually looks.

zhiyi-shen.work: Cool-toned and high in contrast, the way the office and the street around it actually look.
zhiyi-shen.home: A single warm light on her with the rest of the frame dropping away, which is what makes the gap work.

zoey-yeh: Natural light only, with overexposure and soft focus allowed: low contrast and visible grain.
